title: Page Refresh Brief
summary: Diagnose whether one page should be refreshed, consolidated, preserved, or routed to another intervention, then prepare a verification-ready brief.

required_inputs.description: The canonical or intended URL of the page to diagnose.

scope.guidance: Inspect no more than three representative queries needed to distinguish intent and page role.

completion_without.limitation: The method cannot support a search-intent or result-pattern diagnosis without current result evidence.

evidence_plan.fallback: Return an incomplete diagnostic and do not prescribe a content intervention.

scope.guidance: Inspect metadata for the one target page.

completion_without.limitation: The target page cannot be identified and compared reliably without its current metadata.

evidence_plan.fallback: Return an incomplete diagnostic with the unresolved target evidence named.

scope.guidance: Inspect blocking technical signals for the one target page before content comparison.

completion_without.limitation: The method cannot rule out an earlier technical blocker before recommending content work.

evidence_plan.fallback: Return an incomplete diagnostic rather than assuming the page is technically eligible for refresh.

scope.guidance: Read the target and no more than three representative comparison pages.

completion_without.limitation: The method cannot diagnose content gaps, preservation needs, or page overlap without full-page evidence.

evidence_plan.fallback: Return an incomplete diagnostic and request a compatible full-page reader.

scope.guidance: Use one user-supplied or independently authorized performance context for the target page.

evidence_plan.condition: Use first-party evidence only when the user supplies it or authorizes an independent source and the diagnosis requires clicks, conversions, revenue, behavior, or index-state claims.

completion_without.limitation: The result is limited to public page and search evidence and cannot claim first-party performance or index state.

evidence_plan.fallback: Mark operational outcome claims unavailable and continue only with the supported public-evidence diagnosis.

steps.instruction: Confirm the page objective, site role, target market, known query context, and constraints on changes.
Inspect current runtime cost and authorization for page retrieval, result inspection, and comparison.
Inspect a bounded current result set to identify observed intent, result types, and viable page patterns.
Collect observable page content, metadata, and blocking technical signals while recording preservation candidates.
Compare the target with representative results and relevant site pages without treating competitor phrasing as a drafting template.
Classify supported causes across technical access, site role, intent, planning, content, authority, and operational evidence.
Return the diagnostic and, when implementation is justified, a handoff with preserve, change, remove, add, proof, link, acceptance, and verification requirements.

evidence_requirements: The diagnosis records current page evidence and result-page conditions.
Every proposed change or preservation constraint links to an observation or explicit user requirement.
Competing technical, strategic, authority, and operational explanations are considered before prescribing content.
First-party performance claims appear only when supplied or returned by an authorized source.
stop_conditions: Stop content diagnosis when a blocking access or indexing signal makes page comparison misleading.
Stop before paid result inspection when authorization is insufficient.
Return an incomplete diagnostic when the page or required market context cannot be resolved.
completion_criteria: The supported intervention and disposition are explicit.
The diagnostic distinguishes observations, interpretations, competing explanations, and unknowns.
Any implementation handoff is self-contained and contains no finished copy.
Verification criteria protect useful current material and test required changes.

output_contracts.condition: Emit only when the diagnostic is complete and its disposition is proceed or conditional.

bounds.sample_guidance: Inspect only enough representative results and site pages to distinguish intent, page role, and material gaps.
